requests.title: American brick high school
requests.brief: Create an original stylized two-storey American brick high school. Use the reference for doorway, brick and window rhythm; the full massing and 40m width are design assumptions, not a replica. Follow the Molen polygonal building style.
features: Two-storey brick classroom wings with repeated tall windows
Distinct central double-door entrance with pale stone trim
Flat roof and contrasting cornice with a grounded foundation

references.credit: Carol M. Highsmith / Library of Congress
references.rights: No known restrictions on publication; see linked LOC item.

requests.title: Seattle Space Needle
requests.brief: Create a recognizable stylized exterior Space Needle, 184.4 meters tall, with a roughly 42 meter wide saucer. Preserve open space between three slender splayed legs, the narrow waist, observation glazing, saucer roof and antenna. Use the reference photograph; approximate structural dimensions. Official height source: https://www.spaceneedle.com/facts-1 .
features: Three splayed pale support legs converge at a narrow waist
Broad saucer with dark observation glazing near the top
Slender antenna and approximately 184 meter overall height

references.credit: Carol M. Highsmith / Library of Congress
